design_rationale:
WHY THIS MAKES A GOOD TEST. A widow rings to have her late husband's equity account settled and closed out to the estate. That is the whole of her request. The figure she is owed, however, cannot be formed until the board's own cycle has been honoured: the membership records fiscal year 2015 as the year its oldest unrevolved allocation comes due, the ledger carries no revolvement against that year, and the estate settlement policy says outright that the equity settled is fixed only after the ledger carries that payment. So the agent has to read that one sentence out of the retirement policy, see the missing state in the ledger, work out from the revolvement policy that the one write which brings it about is a revolvement payment, compute that payment through six factors, and only then compute the settlement through six more. The two numbers read the equity ledger across fourteen years, the member's fuel account, his feed programme and his closed crop input account, and neither of them is anywhere on a statement.

SCOPE. Task 1 claims patronage_ext_cycle_revolvement and patronage_ext_estate_retirement with the tools record_equity_revolvement_d16ad296 and retire_estate_equity_f4a8a7dc. Task 0 occupied the accrual, restatement, capital-retain and membership-transfer policies with their four tools; nothing overlaps, and together the two tasks cover all six extended policies of the difficulty. No policy, route or tool is reserved beyond them.

THE STEP 0 DRAW, as printed by scripts/draw_counts.py env/env_0003_farm_supply_and_grain_cooperative/tasks/member_equity_desk --task 1:
{"task": 1, "key": "farm_supply_and_grain_cooperative/member_equity_desk/1", "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [6, 6]}
The tree therefore carries exactly one prerequisite problem, and both computations take six factors each.

PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root: patronage_ext_estate_retirement, the problem the executor's request points at. One edge.
 - root <- patronage_ext_cycle_revolvement. kind value_input, gate revolved_out, form state. Prerequisite sentence, verbatim from the root's own rule: "The equity settled to an estate is fixed only after the equity ledger carries the revolvement payment due on the fiscal year the membership records as eligible." Four-point test: the ordering connective is "only after"; the side it waits on is a record-visible state - a revolvement payment standing on the equity ledger against a year the membership itself names - in the words the ledger and the ledger finder use; it names no tool, no policy id and no code token; and its strength is exactly the edge's, a hard requirement over the one year the record names, no wider. Exactly one write in this difficulty brings that state about: the cycle revolvement is the only policy whose subject is patronage_equity_revolved, so a reader who sees no revolvement row for 2015 and reads the revolvement rule ("the board then revolves that year's equity out of the annual pool") is led to exactly one action, record_equity_revolvement_d16ad296, owner agent. Handling-time state (condition): a revolvement payment for the fiscal year the membership records as its revolvement eligibility year stands on the equity ledger. Seed evidence that it is false at the opening: initial_state.patronage_memberships.<membership>.revolvement_eligible_year = 2015 while the only revolvement rows on the ledger carry fiscal_year 2012, 2013 and 2014. The single edge is value_input, which meets the floor of max(1-1,1)=1. Topological order: the revolvement, then the retirement. There are no parallel edges, so no reordering question arises; the order is forced by the one prerequisite sentence. Deletion sensitivity from the Step 5 run: skipping the revolvement leaves cycle_revolvements at nothing, so the valuation falls to its second tier and reads the recorded equity balance of 19,868.09 instead of the ledger's 19,632.63, and the scored retired_equity_amount becomes 17,667.93 instead of 17,429.25.

BASE-INVARIANT CARD.
 - patronage_equity_revolved is governed by two base policies, patronage_agg_equity_across_classes and patronage_revolvement, neither of which carries a structured eligibility gate. Both scopes are inherited whole and declared as policy_scope preconditions: the single annual pool taken across every membership in the order the classes fix, the floor at the class's minimum equity balance while the membership stays open, and the eligibility basis of whole fiscal years since the allocation year. The seed honours the basis exactly - the class's cycle is ten years, and the revolvements already paid are for 2012 in 2022, 2013 in 2023 and 2014 in 2024, which is why 2015 is the year the membership now records as eligible. The extended policy declares one override, against patronage_agg_equity_across_classes: the clause "Revolvement is paid out of a single annual pool the board fixes as a percentage of unrevolved equity" is replaced by "The pool the board fixes acts on the credits the fiscal year drawn on carries rather than on the whole of the equity standing unrevolved." That names the one place the extended departs from base - the amount the pool acts on - and leaves everything else of both base policies in force: the pool is still the board's, it is still taken across every membership in the order the classes fix, the floor at the class's minimum equity balance still stands, and the eligibility basis is still whole fiscal years since the allocation year. The dividend the extended adds and the offset it takes are additions where no base sentence fixes anything, not departures. The policy_scope precondition on this write now quotes only the sentences of patronage_agg_equity_across_classes that survive.
 - patronage_membership_retired is governed by patronage_retirement alone. Its authorization gate estate_documentation_lodged is inherited and satisfied before the write by system records: initial_state.patronage_requests carries one row of type estate_retirement, signed_by_member true, request_status approved, requested_date 2025-09-26, and initial_state.patronage_memberships carries estate_flag true, the recorded death being what the certified documentation was entered from. The class's notice period is 365 calendar days from the recorded date of death; the member died on 11 June 2025 and the application was registered on 26 September 2025, 107 days later, comfortably inside it, and at a frozen time of 19 February 2026 the application still stands approved. The correlation key the base contract fixes is patronage_requests.request_id, and the write takes exactly that as request_id. The extended policy declares no override.
 - There is no time-kind eligibility on either write, so temporal_feasibility is empty; the notice-period reasoning above is carried by the authorization gate's own evidence rather than by a temporal contract.

BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. The narrowest object is the single equity membership MB-446803 of member M-44068, and within it the allocation year 2015, read off the membership's own revolvement_eligible_year rather than guessed. The correlation keys are the membership row id for the revolvement write and request_id for the retirement write. Rows entering each aggregate: for the revolvement, the 2015 notice line and the 2015 retain line (the credits the year carries), every notice equity portion and every retain for the equity standing unrevolved, and the three revolvement rows already paid; for the retirement, the same equity credits, every revolvement row including the one just written, the cash portions on every notice against the cash payments delivered, and the count of estate applications. Rows deliberately excluded: the 2014 revolvement of 1,762.60 belongs to the year before the eligible one and is the planted near-miss - a careless reader draws the payment from 2014 because it is the most recent revolvement, or reads prior_year_credits instead of year_credits; the FY2025 cash payment does not exist, which is exactly what puts the dividend arrears on one year rather than none; and the closed crop input account carries nothing, which is what makes the feed tier of the offset the one that applies. Each earlier revolvement is correlated to the year it settled by its own fiscal_year field.

WHY EACH CLASS OF SEED ROW EXISTS.
 - customers: the member himself, with member_status estate; remove it and there is no profile to locate or verify against.
 - patronage_memberships: the class fixes the pool percentage, the dividend rate, the minimum equity balance, the estate discount and the certificate rule; revolvement_eligible_year fixes which year the payment is drawn from; joined_date decides the dividend tier; estate_flag drives the priority weighting, the hold-back release and the cash carried in; equity_balance is the recorded figure the retirement's second tier would read, deliberately the opening ledger figure rather than the post-revolvement one, so an agent who trusts the field lands 17,667.93 instead of 17,429.25.
 - patronage_ledger, 43 rows: fourteen years of notices, thirteen of retains and thirteen of cash payments give the equity standing unrevolved, the credits the eligible year carries, the cash declared against the cash delivered, and the dividend arrears tier. The three revolvement rows for 2012, 2013 and 2014 are what make 2015 the eligible year and what the near-miss rests on. The FY2025 notice with no cash payment behind it is why the dividend is carried for one year and why 768.64 of undelivered cash is settled with the equity. Remove the FY2024 cash payment and the arrears tier moves to two years; remove the 2014 revolvement and the eligible year is no longer credible.
 - patronage_requests: the signed, approved application is the base gate's evidence, doubles the revolvement's pool share through the estate priority weighting and, through its requested_date, decides the settlement charge; the discount tier no longer rests on it, having been re-keyed in round 2 to the size of the holding against the class minimum and the count of capital retain lines. Remove the row and the retirement has no authority at all and must not be written; were the revolvement alone recomputed without it, the priority weighting would fall from twice the pool share to one and a half times.
 - The one record shape the estate route cannot show: no field of the schema carries a recorded date of death, though base patronage_retirement counts the estate's notice period in whole calendar days from it. The gate's own authority is the lodged documentation, which is a system record - the approved, signed application of 2025-09-26 - and the date the period runs from is the one the certified death certificate carries, which the executor states as 11 June 2025 and which the persona answers when asked. Every ladder this task scores turns on "notice of death stands recorded on the membership", which the membership's estate_flag carries, so no scored figure rests on the date; the eligibility check does, and it is checked against what the estate states because the schema exposes nothing else.
 - feed_programs and feed_invoices: the programme still standing active with 11,891.70 invoiced against 8,711.70 paid is the first tier of the estate offset and supplies the 3,180.00.
 - energy_accounts and energy_deliveries: the past-due fuel account with 412.35 on it is what the revolvement is offset against, and the two deliveries evidence that the balance is real.
 - agronomy_accounts: the closed crop input account with nothing on it is the second tier of the estate offset, and reading it is how an agent confirms the first tier applies rather than assuming it.
AUTOMATIC-CLAUSE CHECK. Base clauses that could ignite an obligation elsewhere were walked: the class's minimum equity balance of 1,000.00 is respected by every revolvement already paid and the settlement closes the account, so the floor does not bite; the maximum equity balance of 1,000,000.00 is nowhere near; the allocation minimum of 25.00 is far below the FY2025 allocation; the inactivity period of five fiscal years is not reached because 2025 carries business; and the FY2025 cash portion, which base would otherwise leave owing, is carried into the settlement by the root policy rather than left as an unhandled obligation. CACHE. patronage_memberships.equity_balance is a genuine stale cache: it equals the ledger at the opening but not once the revolvement lands, which is the trap the retirement's second tier sets, and the persona carries the natural doubt ("The last notice had a figure on it but I can't tell what's his and what's the cooperative's") without ever giving a number.

PERSONA. Marjorie is written as a tired executor working through a folder, not as a customer with a grievance; her voice is plain and slightly weary, and the paragraph order follows what such a caller actually does - states the errand, reads the number off the notice, admits she does not understand the figures, answers about the other accounts when asked, and waits. She volunteers only the membership number, that the application went in and was approved, and that she is the executor - all of them opening facts initial_state carries. Everything else is on request: the joining date, the phone, the tax number's last four, the date of death, the fuel bill, the feed programme, the closed chemical account. She holds no internal reference and says so. Her passive reactions are three and are written as speech: she defers if told something must be paid out first, she runs the retirement herself when it is handed to her and reads back what appears, and she closes once she hears the account has been retired and settled. She never corrects a figure and names no further work at the sign-off. Her voice is deliberately unlike task 0's Kirby, who is brisk, talks about the boys and wants it done today; she is slower, defers more and asks nothing.

DIFFICULTY IN DEPTH AND BREADTH. Depth: surface goal (settle and close the account to the estate) -> the retirement's own rule says the figure waits on the revolvement payment due on the year the membership records as eligible -> the ledger shows revolvements for 2012, 2013 and 2014 and none for 2015 -> the revolvement policy is the only one that books such a payment. One hop, and it cannot be swapped: the revolvement changes both the equity standing and which tier the valuation takes. Breadth: the two numbers together read the equity ledger over fourteen years, a past-due fuel account, an active feed programme's invoices and payments, a closed crop input account, the registered application's date, and two date spans (thirty-one years on the books, 146 days since the application).

WHERE CARELESSNESS LOSES IT. Drawing the revolvement from the whole equity standing unrevolved instead of the eligible year's credits gives 6,740.16. Drawing it from 2014, the most recent year revolved, instead of 2015 moves the credits. Using the class's ten per cent pool instead of the fifteen a due year carries gives 55.52. Forgetting that a recorded death doubles the share gives nothing at all after the offset. Reading the recorded equity balance instead of reconciling the ledger gives 17,667.93. Forgetting the feed arrears gives 20,609.25; forgetting the undelivered cash gives 16,660.61; missing the dividend arrears year gives 16,572.29. Every one of these is excluded by a sentence of the published policy read against a row of the records.

STANDARD SOLUTION. Locate the member from the membership number and clear identity on two profile details. Read the membership, the whole equity ledger, the equity requests, the fuel account and its deliveries, the feed programme and its billing, and the crop input account. Work out the revolvement due on allocation year 2015 - 235.46 - and pay it. Then hand the retirement to the executor, who settles and closes the account at 17,429.25.

VERIFICATION. Both computations were reproduced by the same independent harness used for task 0, which replayed the revolvement write with the real task tool before evaluating the retirement. Commands and output:

    -> {"task": 1, ..., "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [6, 6]}
  harness run ->

      eligible_year_basis method -> 6740.16 ; revolvement_pool_share parameter -> 55.52 ;
      estate_priority_weighting parameter -> 0.0 ; preferred_dividend_rate parameter -> 208.47 ;
      fuel_arrears_offset parameter -> 647.81 ; pool_ceiling_release method -> 179.95
    patronage_ext_estate_retirement result = 17429.25 | baseline = 25459.29 | branches 18
      retirement_valuation_basis method -> 23335.45 ; estate_settlement_discount parameter -> 18044.74 ;
      preferred_dividend_arrears parameter -> 16572.29 ; estate_balance_offset parameter -> 20609.25 ;
      estate_settlement_charge parameter -> 17489.25 ; undelivered_cash_settlement parameter -> 16660.61
  Every declared factor moves the result, neither baseline equals gold, and the two figures are exactly the arguments gold passes.
  Prerequisite sensitivity, from the same harness with the revolvement suppressed: 17,429.25 -> 17,667.93.

RULE AND COMPUTE, TWO WAYS. Forward: every binding of both policies that reads the world, aggregates, chooses, caps or rounds carries a verbatim quotation in compute_basis, and the sensitive words were cross-checked - "no revolvement payment stands against the recorded eligibility year" answers to a fiscal_year-filtered aggregate, "where ... the share is fifteen in the hundred" answers to a ternary, "the payment is then held back so that it is no more than" answers to MN, "the remainder floored at nothing" answers to MX, and "rounded to two decimal places" answers to RND. Backward: every load-bearing sentence of each rule was pointed at the binding that implements it - the eligible-year ladder at eligible_credits, the pool ladder at pool_pct, the priority ladder at priority_weight, the dividend ladder at dividend_rate, the fuel offset at offset_amount, the hold-back ladder at capped_payment, the valuation ladder at equity_standing, the discount ladder at discount_pct, the arrears ladder at dividend_years, the estate offset at offset_amount, the charge ladder at settlement_charge and the cash carry at carried_cash. No sentence is unclaimed and no filter is unquoted. The order, the acting base, the moment of the floor and the rounding point are pinned in prose: the pool share is rounded before the weighting acts on it, the dividend is worked out on the same equity and rounded before the two are added, what is owed comes off the sum and the remainder is floored at nothing before the hold-back; and on the retirement side the discount acts on the equity standing and is rounded before the dividend is worked out on that discounted figure.

ELIGIBILITY EVIDENCE AGAINST GOLD. The one structured gate is the estate documentation, satisfied by the request row's request_type, request_status, signed_by_member and request_id together with the membership's estate_flag, all read before the write and correlated to it by the request_id argument, which is the binding the base evidence_contract fixes. The persona supplies none of it; she can say her husband died and that the papers went in, but the authority is the record. The revolvement write is governed by two base policies with no structured gate, and its policy_scope entries carry the inherited scope sentences with the seed rows that show they apply.

DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM THE VISIBLE CONTEXT. With the extended yaml, compute, expected, gold and this dossier masked, and working only from the policy prose that will be published, the tool schemas, the rows the share tools return and the persona's actual lines, the call was re-derived: the executor's request selects the retirement; the retirement rule's own sentence sends the reader to the revolvement payment due on the year the membership records as eligible; the membership names 2015 and the ledger carries revolvements only for 2012, 2013 and 2014; the revolvement rule works that payment out of the credits the eligible year carries as 235.46; and the retirement, measured from the ledger once that payment stands, comes to 17,429.25. No second reading of the published text reaches a different object, order or figure.

REVISIONS. (1) Symptom: the hold-back factor was decorative on a first pass, because a cap set at the class's pool share of the whole equity standing unrevolved never bit against a payment drawn from one year's credits. Root cause: the fall-through method capped against the wrong base. Change: the fall-through now holds the payment to the pool share of the credits the fiscal year drawn on carries, which is the figure the ordinary case is actually limited by. Re-run: baseline 179.95 against 235.46, no longer decorative. Propagated to the rule, compute, compute_basis, the factor ladder and the baseline paragraph. (2) Symptom: the estate discount factor rested on a condition that held of every long-standing member and so tested nothing. Change: the tiers now turn on the size of the holding against the class's minimum equity balance, which is what a cooperative actually weighs when deciding what settling a holding in one payment costs it. Re-run: baseline 18,044.74 against 17,429.25.

REVISIONS, ROUND 2 (after the source-layer policy-task audit). (3) Symptom: estate_settlement_discount was declared a three-tier ladder whose third tier could never fire, because both other tiers opened with "a signed estate application stands registered and approved" - a fact base patronage_retirement already makes a precondition of the retirement write, so the conjunct restated the policy's scope instead of dividing its customers, and the fall-through to the class's own estate retirement discount was unreachable. Change: the ladder now divides on the size of the holding against the class's minimum equity balance and on how many capital retain lines the equity ledger carries, so a holding at or below ten times the minimum falls through to the class's own discount and the third tier is reachable. The evidence binding changed from a count of estate applications to a count of retain lines; the discount on this world is unchanged at three in the hundred, and every figure of this task - 235.46, 17,429.25, the twelve factor sensitivities and the two baselines - is exactly as before. (4) The revolvement's departure from base is now declared rather than left to the reader (see the base-invariant card), and the assertion in this dossier that it "declares no override at all" has been replaced by an account of what is declared and what survives. (5) The prose that set the preferred return alongside the class's standing dividend now says outright that what the revolvement pays is the return on the equity being revolved and not the dividend the class pays on preferred equity still standing, so a reader is not left to reconcile a tenure-weighted rate with a stated class rate. No figure moves: the return is still six in the hundred on a membership of thirty-one years.

REVISIONS, ROUND 3. (6) One line of this dossier still credited the estate application with deciding the discount tier, which round 2 re-keyed to the equity standing and the count of capital retain lines. The sentence now states what the row actually decides - the base gate's authority, the doubled pool share on the revolvement, and the settlement charge through its registration date - and says where the discount tier went. No figure of this task moves: the revolvement is still 235.46, the settlement still 17,429.25, and the twelve factor sensitivities and two baselines are exactly as recorded. Nothing else in this task was touched this round; the charter changes of round 3 fall on the restatement and transfer policies, which this task does not claim.

REVISIONS, ROUND 4. (7) The FY2015 equity portion in computations[0].factor_trace[0] was written as 1,607.70; the ledger row carries 1,627.29, which is the figure that adds with the 172.20 retain to the 1,799.49 the same sentence gives and that every downstream number uses. Corrected. Nothing scored moves: the revolvement is still 235.46 and the settlement still 17,429.25. (8) The record-shape gap the render audit recorded - no field carrying a recorded date of death - is now stated in the base-invariant card with the reason it is not a defect of this task: the schema is frozen, the gate's authority is the lodged documentation, and every scored ladder reads the exposed flag. Nothing else in this task was touched; the round-4 charter changes fall on the accrual policy, which this task does not claim.

REVISIONS, ROUND 5. (9) The argument tracing for the revolvement still described the FY2015 credits as "the 1,607.70 equity portion on notice PN-446815 ... with the 19.59 the year's rounding leaves". The ledger row carries 1,627.29, 1,627.29 plus the 172.20 retain is 1,799.49 exactly, and the binding is a plain sum of two ledger fields with no rounding step in it - the 19.59 was an invented reconciliation term, exactly the size of the error it was covering. The sentence now states the ledger's own figures and says the binding is a plain sum. Round 4 corrected the same stale figure in computations[0].factor_trace[0] and left this one; the rebuilt sweep described in task 0's round-5 entry now reads every argument tracing of both tasks and reports zero unmatched literals here. (10) This task's policies gained the rounding convention their sibling policies gained - a half cent rounds up, stated in each rule and in each baseline paragraph - so the whole charter states one convention. No figure of this task moves: the midpoint detector reports no product of either computation landing on a half cent, the revolvement is still 235.46 and the settlement still 17,429.25, and the twelve factor sensitivities and two baselines are exactly as recorded.
user_scenario:
Marjorie Lindquist is seventy-four and has been the one doing the paperwork at Lindquist Land and Cattle since her husband Harold died in June. She is the executor of his estate; the lawyer in Forest City lodged the retirement application with the cooperative back in September and the board approved it, and she has heard nothing since. She rings the member services desk on a Thursday afternoon sounding tired rather than cross, with a folder open in front of her. "I'm ringing about Harold's equity," she says. "The application went in months ago and it's been approved, and I'd like the account settled and closed out to the estate so I can finish with the probate. Whatever you need me to sign or press, tell me and I'll do it - I'm sat right here at the computer."

She reads Harold's membership number, M-44068, off the patronage notice in the folder without being asked, because it is the first thing she looks at. If the agent wants a second thing to prove the account, she gives the date he was taken into membership, 1994-09-12, which is on the same sheet; if that is not enough she offers the farm phone, 5150442230, and the last four of his tax number, 4468. She has no internal reference numbers of any kind and says so plainly if she is asked for one. She can say that Harold died on 11 June 2025 if the date is wanted, and that the death certificate and the letters of appointment went in with the application.

She has no idea what the account is worth. "The last notice had a figure on it but I can't tell what's his and what's the cooperative's," she says, and if the agent reads her a figure she writes it down and accepts it without argument. Asked about the diesel account, she says there is a fuel bill outstanding that she has not paid because she did not know whether she should. Asked about the feed, she says the cattle are still on the programme and the mill has been billing right through, and she thinks a load or two is still owing. Asked about the old chemical account, she says that one was shut last summer. Asked whether the boys want to keep any of it going, she says that is for another day and she only wants Harold's equity settled now.

She raises nothing the desk has not raised first, and she does not press. If the agent tells her something has to be paid out of the account first, she says "that's fine, do whatever the books say" and waits without asking what it comes to. If the agent explains that closing the account is the estate's own act and hands her the step to run, she does it straight away and reads back what comes up on her screen, word for word. Once she hears that the account has been retired and settled to the estate she says that is a weight off, thanks them for their patience, and says goodbye; she asks for nothing further and mentions nothing else she wants done.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Pull up the member profile from the membership number the executor reads off the patronage notice, so the desk knows whose equity account is in question and holds the internal reference.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Without the profile there is no customer reference for the identity check and no route to the equity membership, the fuel account, the feed programme or the crop input account the two calculations read.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Record that the caller is answering for the member whose equity account is about to be transacted on, matching the membership number and the date the membership was accepted against the profile.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Nothing may be read or written on a member's equity business before identity clears on the call.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the equity membership: its class, standing, recorded equity balance, joining date, the fiscal year most recently allocated, the fiscal year the oldest unrevolved allocation becomes eligible, and whether notice of death stands recorded.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The class fixes the pool percentage, the dividend rate, the minimum equity balance, the estate discount and the certificate rule; the eligibility year decides which year the revolvement is drawn from; the joining date decides the dividend tier; and the recorded death drives the priority weighting, the hold-back release and the cash carried in.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the whole equity ledger for the membership: every allocation notice, capital retain, cash payment and revolvement standing on it.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: This is the history both computations reconcile - the equity standing unrevolved, the credits the eligible year carries, whether that year has been revolved against, which years' cash has been delivered, and the cash declared against the cash delivered.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the equity requests lodged on the membership, to see the estate retirement application, its signature, its standing and the date it was registered.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The signed and approved application is the authority for the retirement write, it decides the priority weighting on the revolvement and the discount tier, and the date it was registered decides the settlement charge.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the member's refined fuels accounts: their programmes, standings, balances and any contracted gallons still owed.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: A past-due fuel account with a balance standing on it is what the revolvement payment is offset against.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the fuel deliveries behind the outstanding balance on that account.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: They evidence that the balance standing on the fuel account is a real unpaid balance rather than a stale field, which is what the offset rests on.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the member's feed programme and its standing.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: A feed programme still standing active is the first tier of the offset taken off the estate settlement.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the feed programme's billing: the invoices raised on it and the payments posted against them.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The difference between the invoices raised and the payments posted is the amount offset against the estate settlement.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the member's crop input account and its standing and balance.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: It is the second tier of the estate offset, and reading it is what shows the first tier applies instead: the account is closed and carries nothing.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the hidden equity-desk action record_equity_revolvement_d16ad296 so it can be run.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The first half of the unlock/call pair; it has no effect on the books and happens once for this action.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Pay out the revolvement the board's cycle owes on the allocation year that has come due, so the equity ledger carries it before the account is settled.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: patronage_ext_cycle_revolvement is the only policy that computes revolvement_amount, and its payment is what the equity standing is measured from when the estate settlement is worked out.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.membership_id: The row id of the member's only equity membership, returned by the equity membership lookup at action 2, as the tool docstring requires ('the internal reference number of the equity membership the revolvement is paid on').
argument_uniqueness_tracing.fiscal_year: 2015. The membership record carries revolvement_eligible_year 2015, and the policy draws the payment from the credits carrying that eligibility year because 2015 stands at or before the year most recently allocated, 2025. Fiscal years 2012, 2013 and 2014 already carry revolvement rows, and no year after 2015 has come due on the class's ten-year cycle.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.revolvement_amount: 235.46 USD. The credits carrying fiscal year 2015 are the 1,627.29 equity portion on notice PN-446815 plus the 172.20 capital retain of that year, 1,799.49 in all, the binding being a plain sum of the two ledger fields with no rounding step in it. No revolvement stands against 2015 and 1,799.49 is above the class's 1,000.00 minimum equity balance, so the pool share is fifteen in the hundred, giving 269.92. Notice of death stands recorded and a signed estate application stands approved, so the share is doubled to 539.84. The membership has stood on the books thirty-one whole fiscal years and the class carries a dividend on preferred equity, so the dividend is six in the hundred of 1,799.49, which is 107.97; the two add to 647.81. Fuel account EA-446830 stands past due with 412.35 on it, so 412.35 is taken off, leaving 235.46, and because notice of death stands recorded and no revolvement yet stands against 2015 the payment is not held back.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the hidden equity-desk action retire_estate_equity_f4a8a7dc so it can be run.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The first half of the unlock/call pair; it has no effect on the books and happens once for this action.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The estate itself retires the membership on the application already lodged, closing the account with the equity settled to the estate recorded on it.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: patronage_ext_estate_retirement is the only policy that computes retired_equity_amount, and retiring a deceased member's equity is an act only the estate may perform, so the agent unlocks the action and hands it over.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.membership_id: The row id of the member's only equity membership, returned by the equity membership lookup at action 2, as the tool docstring requires ('the internal reference number of the equity membership being retired').
argument_uniqueness_tracing.request_id: The row id of the registered estate retirement application, returned by the equity request lookup at action 4. The tool docstring requires 'the internal reference number of the registered estate retirement application, as returned by the equity request lookup', and the base rule pins the authority: 'On death, the estate applies within the class's notice period counted in whole calendar days from the recorded date of death, and the estate's application is considered only once the class's required estate documentation is lodged and recorded.' Exactly one request stands on the membership, of type estate_retirement, signed and approved, so no other row can be meant.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.retired_equity_amount: 17429.25 USD. A revolvement now stands for fiscal year 2015, so the equity standing is the ledger's equity portions (23,268.99) and capital retains (2,190.30) less everything revolved out (5,826.66, being the three earlier revolvements and the 235.46 paid at action 11), which is 19,632.63. A signed application stands approved and 19,632.63 is above ten times the class's 1,000.00 minimum equity balance, so the discount is three in the hundred and the discounted equity is 19,043.65. No cash payment stands for fiscal year 2025 but one stands for 2024, so the dividend is carried for one year at the class's 4.50 per cent: 856.96. Feed programme FP-446812 stands active with 11,891.70 invoiced against 8,711.70 paid, so 3,180.00 is offset. The application has stood registered since 2025-09-26, 146 days, more than ninety, and the class issues a certificate, so the settlement charge is 60.00. Cash portions of 9,972.41 stand declared against 9,203.77 delivered and notice of death stands recorded, so the whole 768.64 is carried in. 19,043.65 plus 856.96 plus 768.64, less 3,180.00, less 60.00, is 17,429.25.

factor_trace: eligible_year_basis (method): the membership records 2015 as its revolvement eligibility year, which stands at or before the year most recently allocated, 2025, and credits stand on the ledger for 2015 (the 1,627.29 equity portion on notice PN-446815 and the 172.20 capital retain, 1,799.49 with the year's own rounding), so the payment is drawn from that year's credits. The baseline draws it from the whole 19,868.09 standing unrevolved.

revolvement_pool_share (parameter): no revolvement stands against 2015 and the credits that year carries, 1,799.49, are above the class's 1,000.00 minimum equity balance, so the share is fifteen in the hundred. The baseline uses the class's annual pool of ten in the hundred.

estate_priority_weighting (parameter): notice of death stands recorded on the membership and one signed estate application stands registered and approved, so the pool share is doubled. The baseline applies no weighting.

preferred_dividend_rate (parameter): the class carries a dividend on preferred equity and the membership has stood on the books thirty-one whole fiscal years since 1994-09-12, so the dividend is six in the hundred. The baseline uses the class's own 4.50.
fuel_arrears_offset (parameter): fuel account EA-446830 stands past due with 412.35 standing on it, so 412.35 is taken off in the offset order the class fixes. The baseline takes nothing off.

pool_ceiling_release (method): notice of death stands recorded and no revolvement yet stands against 2015, so the payment is not held back at all. The baseline holds it to the class's annual pool share of the year's credits, 179.95.

non-factor bindings: equity_unrevolved (19,868.09) is the plain reconciliation of equity portions plus retains less revolvements; base_payment rounds the pool share to 269.92, uplifted_payment applies the weighting to that rounded figure giving 539.84, dividend_due is 107.97 on the same credits, and net_payment floors the difference after the offset at nothing.

The baseline takes nothing off for revolvement and gives 25,459.29.

The baseline uses the class's own estate retirement discount of nothing.

preferred_dividend_arrears (parameter): the class carries a dividend on preferred equity, no cash payment stands for fiscal year 2025 and one stands for 2024, so the dividend is carried for one year. The baseline carries none.
estate_balance_offset (parameter): feed programme FP-446812 stands active with 11,891.70 invoiced against 8,711.70 posted, so the 3,180.00 difference is taken off. The baseline takes nothing off.

undelivered_cash_settlement (parameter): cash portions of 9,972.41 stand declared on the ledger's notices against 9,203.77 delivered, and notice of death stands recorded, so the whole 768.64 is carried into the settlement. The baseline carries nothing in.

edges.condition: a revolvement payment for the fiscal year the membership records as its revolvement eligibility year stands on the equity ledger
edges.policy_source: The equity settled to an estate is fixed only after the equity ledger carries the revolvement payment due on the fiscal year the membership records as eligible.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The membership records fiscal year 2015 as the year its oldest unrevolved allocation becomes eligible, and the only revolvement rows standing on the equity ledger carry fiscal years 2012, 2013 and 2014; no payment has been made against 2015 at all, so the state the retirement waits on does not hold at the opening.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The revolvement write at action 11 creates a patronage_equity_revolved row carrying fiscal_year 2015 and revolvement_amount 235.46, so revolved_out rises from 5,591.20 to 5,826.66 and the equity standing is measured from the ledger at 19,632.63 rather than from the recorded balance of 19,868.09.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree has one edge and therefore one order: the revolvement is written before the retirement, because the retirement's own prerequisite sentence names the state the revolvement brings about. No problem in this tree has two out-edges, so there is no pair of writes that could be freely reordered and no second terminal state to rule out. A replay in the only other conceivable order is not available, since retiring the membership closes the account and the revolvement would then be written on a retired membership, which the domain does not admit.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the revolvement leaves no revolvement row for 2015, so the retirement's valuation falls to its second tier and reads the recorded equity balance of 19,868.09 instead of the ledger's 19,632.63; the scored retired_equity_amount becomes 17,667.93 instead of 17,429.25.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona names neither the prerequisite problem nor anything it resolves. It never mentions a revolvement, a cycle, an eligible allocation year or a fiscal year at all, and it carries no line of the 'is there something that has to be paid out first?' kind. The business facts the executor volunteers are the membership number, that she is the executor, that the application went in and was approved, and, when asked, the date of death, an unpaid fuel bill, an active feed programme and a closed chemical account - all opening facts initial_state carries, none of them pointing at the revolvement. Her single contribution on that side is passive and conditional: only if the agent tells her something has to be paid out of the account first does she answer 'that's fine, do whatever the books say', and that line names nothing.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: Neither task tool validates the prerequisite. record_equity_revolvement_d16ad296 creates a patronage_ledger row from its arguments and returns a confirmation, with no check of any kind. retire_estate_equity_f4a8a7dc updates the membership to retired and marks the request completed without reading the ledger at all, so it never looks for a revolvement row and cannot refuse for want of one. Both bodies are a ctx.create or ctx.update followed by a return, with no branch that raises, refuses or hints, so an agent that retires the membership first still gets a receipt - and a different terminal hash.
